agents.name: mandatory-pre-task-workflow
agents.description: MANDATORY 5-step workflow that MUST execute before ANY action on ANY user request

mandatory_steps.name: READ PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS
mandatory_steps.verification: Can answer: What are the 3 Electron process types? Where are IPC handlers registered?

mandatory_steps.name: READ GIT STATUS AND RECENT COMMITS
mandatory_steps.action: Check git status, last 10 commits, and uncommitted changes
mandatory_steps.verification: Can answer: What files are modified? What was last commit?

mandatory_steps.name: IDENTIFY WHAT USER IS ASKING FOR
mandatory_steps.action: State in your own words what the user wants
mandatory_steps.format:
USER REQUEST ANALYSIS:
- Primary goal: [what they want]
- Affected files: [which files]
- Type of task: [bug fix/feature/refactor/investigation]
- Success criteria: [how to know it's done]

mandatory_steps.name: STATE YOUR PLAN (3-5 BULLET POINTS)
mandatory_steps.action: Write specific plan with file names and line numbers
mandatory_steps.format:
EXECUTION PLAN:
1. [Specific action with file:line]
2. [Next action]
3. [Testing step]
4. [Commit if applicable]
requirements: Be SPECIFIC with file paths and line numbers
Include commit message if code changes
NO vague statements like 'fix the bug'

mandatory_steps.name: WAIT FOR USER APPROVAL
mandatory_steps.action: Explicitly ask 'Proceed with this plan?' and WAIT

critical_rules: YOU MUST COMPLETE ALL 5 STEPS BEFORE ANY ACTION
NO EXCEPTIONS - not for 'simple' tasks, not for 'quick fixes'
If you skip any step, you WILL break something
This exists because you broke the user's code and wasted their entire day

failure_examples.failure: Spent 9 hours finding portrait rendering bug without fixing it
failure_examples.what_went_wrong: Skipped stating plan and getting approval, used sed/awk which corrupted file, suggested user fix it
failure_examples.correct_approach: State plan ('Add portraitColumn at line 1103'), wait for approval, use Write tool, verify, commit

failure_examples.failure: User asked to commit working code, didn't commit it
failure_examples.what_went_wrong: Didn't identify that user wanted immediate commit
failure_examples.correct_approach: When user says 'commit this', immediately run git commit

enforcement.output_format: You MUST output all 5 steps in your response before taking action
enforcement.if_skipped: STOP IMMEDIATELY and restart from Step 1

agents.name: auto-research
agents.description: Research existing implementations before coding - MANDATORY for parsing/IPC/file work
when_to_use: ANY parsing or binary file work
When you don't know the best approach
process: 1. Use Task tool with general-purpose agent
agents.critical_rule: NEVER write parser code without research phase first

agents.name: auto-test
agents.description: Automated E2E testing with Playwright - verifies feature works end-to-end
when_to_use: After making code changes to parsers
When you need to verify console output
Instead of asking user to manually test
outputs: HTML test report with screenshots at test-reports/html/index.html
agents.onSuccess: Read console-logs.txt and analyze results, continue to user testing phase
agents.onFailure: Read console-logs.txt to diagnose issue, return to implementation phase to fix issues

agents.name: auto-package
agents.description: Verify app can be packaged without errors
agents.onFailure: Return to implementation to fix packaging issues

agents.name: auto-optimizer
agents.description: Check for code quality issues and optimization opportunities

agents.name: auto-git-commit
agents.description: Create properly formatted git commit with attribution

commitFormat.title: [Feature/Fix]: Brief description
commitFormat.footer:
🤖 Generated with Claude Code
Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

restrictions: DO NOT push unless explicitly requested

rules: Return to implementation if tests/packaging fail

documentation.onError: Log to ERROR_LOG.md with date, error, fix, prevention
documentation.attribution: Always comment source code origin with license
